item.title: Personal Notes on Research
item.description: If you can’t Claude, you GPT for summary and discussion compared to Gemini. I find the overall experience to be much more pleasant. Without Gemini, it feels more liike a conversation with a chronic gaslighter. Start with LLM-generated broad summary of the content. Then familiarise yourself with the main ideas, new jargon and key assumptions. Following this proceed with reading the text. While this feels like a surrender to AI, it is not.

item.title: Novel Depth Esitmation(Edge focussed)
item.description: Tiny Marigold - Depth - Paper Take inspiration from the marigold paper use a Vae - stable diffusion or some other(compare different if possible) lightweight Denoising End result light weight diffusion based depth estimation.
